research_question: Can typed verifier residuals make test-time compute useful for multi-agent proof-carrying action systems by turning failed verifier checks into structured repair decisions selected by a RepairAgent under a fixed compiler and MetaVerifier?
allowed_test_time_actions: run proof agents on a frozen prompt/proof schema
emit typed residual packets from verifier failures
ask RepairAgent to select primitive IDs from the frozen primitive library
compile selected primitives with the frozen deterministic compiler
accept only proposals accepted by the frozen MetaVerifier
rerun or continue proof search under accepted frozen frontiers
forbidden_test_time_actions: manual residual taxonomy after seeing held-out outcomes
adding new primitive IDs or proof families
editing parser, verifier, compiler, or MetaVerifier
prompt-only repairs counted as frontier repairs
opening sealed AppWorld variations before this protocol is frozen

retrospective_replay_scope.purpose: mechanics check only; not a held-out test-time compute claim

prospective_heldout_scope.split_policy: freeze protocol and code before generating or opening fresh held-out task outcomes
prospective_heldout_scope.preferred_source: fresh AppWorld variations 10-12 generated after freeze, or another preregistered held-out split

claim_boundary: v30 retrospective replay can validate the frozen loop mechanics, but only a preregistered held-out run can support a test-time compute claim.
